name: io.github.overstarry/submitnow
title: submitnow — IndexNow & AI Search Indexing
description: Free open-source IndexNow MCP server for Bing, ChatGPT Search, Copilot, Yandex, Naver, Seznam & Yep.

tools.name: indexnow_generate_key
tools.description: Generate a cryptographically random 48-character hexadecimal IndexNow ownership key locally.

tools.name: indexnow_check_key
tools.description: Verify a public IndexNow key file for 404s, soft-404 HTML, UTF-8 BOMs, off-host redirects, and exact body match (SSRF-guarded).

keyLocation.description: Optional custom key file URL on the same host

tools.name: indexnow_fetch_sitemap
tools.description: Fetch a public XML sitemap, .xml.gz file, or nested sitemapindex with optional lastmod day filtering (SSRF-guarded).

url.description: Public http(s) URL to sitemap.xml or sitemap index

maxAgeDays.description: Optional lastmod lookback window in days (e.g. 1, 7, 30)

tools.name: indexnow_submit_urls
tools.description: Validate host, protocol, and subdirectory keyLocation scope, then submit same-host URLs (auto-chunked in 10,000-URL batches) to api.indexnow.org or a chosen search engine endpoint.

urls.description: List of absolute http(s) URLs belonging to one host

key.description: IndexNow ownership key hosted on the target domain

host.description: Optional hostname override (inferred from urls if omitted)

keyLocation.description: Optional custom key file URL on the same host

dryRun.description: Validate and preview batches without sending HTTP requests
